    "Phase" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "DefenceHourUtc" INTEGER NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "CK_guild_outpost_bounds" CHECK (Tile >= 0 AND Revision >= 0 AND ConsecutiveAborts >= 0),

    "Command" BLOB NOT NULL,
    "CommandDigest" BLOB NOT NULL,
    "TransitionId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "NextHeadId" TEXT NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_action" CHECK (length(Action) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_actor" CHECK (length(ActorKey) = 64 AND ActorKey NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_audit" CHECK (AuditId > 0 AND length(AuditProjection) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_command" CHECK (length(Command) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 AND length(CommandDigest) = 32),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_ids" CHECK (length(Id) = 36 AND length(RequestId) = 36 AND length(TransitionId) = 36 AND length(NextHeadId) = 36),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_reason" CHECK (length(CAST(Reason AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_outpost_admin_result" CHECK (length(Result) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536)
)
